title: [Finder] Many tests failures for Finder component
body:
@fabpot @jfsimon
Hi,
I get many failures running tests for Finder component on my Mac Book Pro with OS X 10.8.2.
On wich operating systems these tests are supposed to pass?

If you run this (https://gist.github.com/4288294) simple script on OS X (tested both 10.8 and 10.7) you can see that the output is different than linux (Ubuntu for example).

I attach my test output.
Let me know, thank you.

Bye.
